knowledge.name: Fixed synthetic mortgage application snapshot
knowledge.detail: Bundled fictional applications, product criteria, rates, documents, conditions, statuses, amounts, and ratios support deterministic demos.

knowledge.name: Lending controls and review contract
knowledge.detail: Packaged rules define evidence grounding, fair-lending boundaries, missing-evidence handling, and mandatory officer and underwriter review.

knowledge.name: Operation skills and locked evidence anchors
knowledge.detail: Five skills map persona language to source-backed procedures, synthetic case anchors, prohibited actions, and explicit reviewer checkpoints.

intelligence_processing.name: Application pipeline and intake review
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes fictional applications by identifier, borrower, product, amount, LTV, status, owner, pipeline volume, and packaged rate sheet.

intelligence_processing.name: Credit and collateral ratio analysis
intelligence_processing.detail: Calculates DTI and LTV, presents credit and DSCR evidence, and compares fixed product criteria without deciding creditworthiness.

intelligence_processing.name: Product-specific document readiness
intelligence_processing.detail: Builds income, asset, property, identity, FHA, VA, or commercial checklists for processor and underwriter verification.

intelligence_processing.name: Nonbinding eligibility findings
intelligence_processing.detail: Surfaces stated-criteria results and exceptions for underwriting review while making no approval, denial, pricing, or lock decision.

intelligence_processing.name: Condition and timeline review
intelligence_processing.detail: Lists open conditions by application and preserves owner, due-date, condition-clearance, and closing-date boundaries for human follow-up.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio conversational workspace
clients_user_interface.detail: Provides natural-language access through a validated Draft agent with five skills, two synthetic knowledge files, and web search removed.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs LoanOriginationAssistantAgent through local Brainstem chat and UI endpoints with deterministic synthetic-only operation routing.

clients_user_interface.name: Role-based lending review experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Loan officers, processors, underwriters, and closing coordinators receive evidence-first outputs with explicit human review gates.

management_reporting.name: Mortgage pipeline status report
management_reporting.detail: Reports fictional application counts, total pipeline value, product, amount, LTV, workflow status, and assigned loan officer.

management_reporting.name: Credit and eligibility exception review
management_reporting.detail: Shows source inputs, calculated DTI and LTV, credit or DSCR evidence, fixed criteria, exceptions, and nonbinding review findings.

management_reporting.name: Document readiness checklist
management_reporting.detail: Presents product-specific evidence for processor, loan officer, and underwriter review without claiming verification or completeness.

management_reporting.name: Conditions and closing-readiness report
management_reporting.detail: Lists open conditions and missing ownership or due dates while confirming that no condition was cleared and no closing date was promised.

tools.name: Portable LoanOriginationAssistantAgent RAPP tool
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent implements five read-only operations over bundled synthetic mortgage evidence and fixed calculations.

tools.name: Brainstem runtime
tools.detail: Local-first RAPP server discovers the portable tool and exposes conversational chat, streaming, health, and agent endpoints.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the Draft conversational package, two synthetic knowledge files, and five skills; publication requires explicit confirmation.

tools.name: Approved loan-origination system
tools.detail: Production connection seam for application, condition, owner, and due-date context; it is not connected to the synthetic package.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 borrower or relationship data
tools.detail: Approved future seam for governed borrower and relationship context; current demonstrations use only bundled fictional records.

tools.name: Approved lending verification services
tools.detail: Future least-privilege seam for credit, income, asset, and property evidence; no live verification or eligibility decision is configured.

tools.name: Controlled document repository
tools.detail: Approved future seam for governed lending documents; the current package uses uploaded synthetic knowledge and checklists instead.

tools.name: Microsoft Teams underwriting approvals
tools.detail: Approved collaboration seam for human review; the package does not request approval, send messages, or execute lending actions.

supporting_features.name: Fixed synthetic evidence policy
supporting_features.detail: Uses only bundled fictional records and forbids browsing, enrichment, substitution, or invention of missing lending facts.

supporting_features.name: Five deterministic operations
supporting_features.detail: Routes application review, credit analysis, document verification, decision findings, and condition tracking from persona-language prompts.

supporting_features.name: Evidence-first and fail-closed handling
supporting_features.detail: Separates facts, calculations, criteria, and missing evidence and rejects unknown application identifiers rather than substituting records.

supporting_features.name: Loan officer and underwriter review gates
supporting_features.detail: Preserves loan officer preparation and requires authorized underwriter review before any eligibility, credit, or customer-facing action.

supporting_features.name: Fair-lending and compliance boundary
supporting_features.detail: Requires fair-lending, compliance, disclosure, delegated-authority, closing, and funding review by authorized personnel.

supporting_features.name: No autonomous approval or side effects
supporting_features.detail: Prevents approval, denial, pricing, quoting, locking, disclosure, condition clearance, closing, funding, outreach, and record changes.

supporting_features.name: Locked validation and publication control
supporting_features.detail: Five persona cases pass in strict isolation and Copilot Studio artifacts remain Draft and unpublished until separately approved.
